title: Wynnchurch Capital Completes Take-Private Acquisition of Luxfer Holdings PLC
summary: ROSEMONT, Ill., November 19, 2026--Wynnchurch Capital, L.P. ("Wynnchurch") today announced that an affiliate of Wynnchurch completed its acquisition of Luxfer Holdings PLC ("Luxfer" or the "Company") in an all-cash take-private transaction. Luxfer is now a privately held company, and its ordinary shares have ceased trading and will be delisted from the New York Stock Exchange.
